note: Commercial RV park at 182 Boll Weevil Rd, Waynesboro, about 10 minutes from Plant Vogtle; the operator markets it to Vogtle workers and long-term guests as well as weekenders. Leashed pets welcome. --Claude
summary: plantationpinesrvpark.com IS the operator's live site (owner Ben Seay, phone 706-871-0100 matches); the note's 'No dedicated official site found' was wrong and is removed. Confirmed 20/30/50 A full hookups, free laundry, no Wi-Fi; 50x70-ft lots. No nightly rate: packages only ($75/3-day, $150/7-day, $425/30-day), pitched at Plant Vogtle workers - long-stay/workforce character flagged. No season stated.
flags: LONG-STAY / WORKFORCE (tests 2 and 4): the operator's own booking page offers no single night - only 'Pines Weekend Retreat' '$75 For 3-Day Stay', 'The Weekly Retreat' '$150 For 7-Day Stay' and 'Pines Extended Stay' '$425 For 30-Day Stay' - and markets the park as 'Perfect for Vogtle Workers ... a quiet, comfortable home base ideal for Vogtle workers and long-term guests'. The shortest stay sold online is the 3-day weekend package (whether that is 2 or 3 nights isn't stated); a one-night stay isn't offered anywhere on the site (maybe by phone). That is an effective 2-3 night minimum and workforce character - for AWH's decision.
PRICE: $75 for the 3-day stay is $25-37.50 a night either way, well under US$50.
PRESENCE passes: live operator website with phone 706-871-0100 and online payment. Its 'guest' testimonials are template placeholders (e.g. 'Sarah Jenkins, Airstream Owner'), not real reviews.
